mechanism: Nafcillin induces hepatic metabolism (CYP3A4, CYP2C9) which may reduce pyrazinamide exposure; both drugs can cause hepatotoxicity and hyperuricemia, with additive effects on liver function.
action: Monitor liver function tests (AST, ALT, bilirubin) regularly; assess serum uric acid levels and clinical signs of gout; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative agents if hepatic impairment develops.
